title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 16 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 16:15. Yesterday evening, the page called it may be high, about 5,500 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 5,400 ft by the Kekoa camera, 100 ft lower than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,600 ft, off by 200 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 5,800 ft, off by 400 ft. Most of the day the shear line was on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului; furthest south about 17:07, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Upper Kahikinui stopped at 07:50; Kahikinui stopped at 07:55; the Mesonet could not be reached on 4 of 55 updates.
